description: This file is a test script for the 'git p4' integration, specifically testing the 'preserve-users' functionality in various scenarios. It sets up a Perforce server environment, creates users, performs Git commits with various authors, and checks the preservation or rejection of user information when submitting changes to Perforce via 'git p4'.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Grants admin rights to a specified user in Perforce.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks if the latest change in Perforce for a given depot file is authored by a specified user.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a change in a file with specified username, name, and email, commits it to Git accordingly.
